messages.text: Thick morning fog, jazz in the air, and a quiet shift in Lansing

A warm, foggy Saturday invites a slow pace before a significant shift in legislative leadership begins to take shape for Canton. Meanwhile, researchers are exploring foundational questions in mathematics and the mechanics of human speech.
Expect fog throughout the day with a high near 65 degrees and a low around 33 degrees, along with a 57 percent chance of precipitation.
The sun rises at 7:33 AM and sets at 5:07 PM, with the moon currently in a waxing gibbous phase at 92.1 percent illumination.
A day for music and quiet reflection
The Earl V. Moore Building in Ann Arbor hosts Small Jazz Ensembles at 7:00 PM, offering a chance to hear student musicians perform original repertoire.
Mark your calendar for the 862 Meeting scheduled for November 25 at 6:30 PM.

Incoming House Speaker Ranjeev Puri of Canton will soon lead a state legislature with a growing progressive caucus focused on tax and ethics reform. Additionally, Ypsilanti Township has scheduled a panel discussion at Eastern Michigan University to examine the proposed University of Michigan and Los Alamos National Laboratory computing research center.
Prepare for a change in conditions tomorrow, as the forecast shifts to heavy snow.
